events.text:
A FRIENDLY WORD
Pell the lamplighter

Pell lowers his pole and leans down to your skiff. "Heard something on my rounds. Tomorrow: Collectors from the deep city want Ghost Chips, and they are shopping at Saint Mire."

Pell is sure. Rumours like this land in full about 8 times in 10.
If it holds, tomorrow at Saint Mire: sell Ghost Chips there. It is one night away, so you can be there when it lands. Either way, you will hear what really happened.
